name: Twitter Automations
description: Handles three recurring X chores: messaging anyone who comments a chosen keyword, collecting new followers that clear a minimum audience size, and watching a fixed set of accounts. Aimed at creators already posting regularly, since keyword replies and follower flow are what it feeds on.

official.title: Twitter Automations by NM
official.description: Three X automations for creators: DM people who comment a keyword on a post, queue new followers above a size floor, and spy a locked list of accounts...
